skills.name: fx-declined-skill
skills.description: Use when webhook deliveries pile up in the retry queue; checks whether retries back off or fire on a fixed interval.
skills.body:
# Diagnose webhook retry floods

## Steps
1. Check whether the retry delay grows between attempts or stays fixed.
2. Check whether a 410 response stops the retries.

messages.content: The webhook retry queue grew to 2 million entries overnight. What happened?

I loaded the fx-declined-skill skill and followed its first step. Retries fire every 5 seconds with no backoff, and a subscriber that went away answers 410, which the client treats as retryable, so every delivery to it retries forever.

findings.summary: Webhook retries use a fixed 5-second interval with no backoff, and a 410 response is treated as retryable, so deliveries to a gone subscriber retry forever.
